title: Primary suffix
textbookText: The word root is linked to the suffix which may be primary or secondary or both.
Observe the nature of the bonds between carbon and carbon atoms in these three
o First compound has a single bond between all carbon atoms. o Second compound has one double bond between carbon atoms. o Third compound has one triple bond between carbon atoms.
Primary suffix helps to identify whether the compounds are either saturated or unsaturated.
So, the first compound is saturated and the second and third compounds are unsaturated
compounds. So, the primary suffix for the first compound is -ane and the second compound
is -ene and the third compound is -yne. Primary suffix is written immediately after the word
root. It indicates the nature of linkage in the carbon chain.
